# Code of Conduct

Participants in the Limes project are expected to be respectful and professional.
Harassment, discrimination, personal attacks and publishing others' private information
are not acceptable. Maintainers may remove comments, commits, issues and other
contributions that violate this standard and may ban repeat offenders.

Report conduct problems privately via GitHub on https://github.com/TyrusRC/limes
(Security Advisories or a direct message to the maintainer, TyrusRC).
